patterns.name: Repository Visibility Changed to Public
patterns.description: Critical security alert when a private internal repository is flipped to public.
patterns.cql: #repo = "github-audit-logs" Vendor.action = "repo.access_change" Vendor.visibility = "public" | select([@timestamp, Vendor.actor, Vendor.repo, client.geo.country_iso_code])

patterns.name: Organization Owner Added
patterns.description: Alerts when a user is granted organization-level admin/owner permissions.
patterns.cql: #repo = "github-audit-logs" Vendor.action = "org.add_member" Vendor.permission = "admin" | select([@timestamp, Vendor.actor, Vendor.user, Vendor.org])

patterns.name: Deploy Key with Write Access Added
patterns.description: Tracks addition of repository deploy keys configured with push/write permissions.
